description: This file defines service functions for managing OpenAI assistants, including listing all assistants, retrieving a single assistant with associated files, and uploading files to an assistant. It interacts with OpenAI API, database credentials, and file utilities.

methods.name: getAllOpenaiAssistants
methods.description: Fetches a list of all OpenAI assistants associated with a given credential ID, handling credential decryption and API interaction.

methods.name: getSingleOpenaiAssistant
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OpenAI assistant, including associated files and vector store data, based on credential and assistant IDs.

methods.name: uploadFilesToAssistant
methods.description: Uploads specified files to an OpenAI assistant, handling file conversion, upload, and cleanup.
